scope: Targeted primary-source review, not a systematic review. Event-family evidence is not validation of simulator coefficients or compound trajectories.

sources.title: Dietary Fat Acutely Increases Glucose Concentrations and Insulin Requirements in Patients With Type 1 Diabetes
sources.support: Seven adults completed a crossover comparison of higher- versus lower-fat dinners with matched carbohydrate/protein; glucose and insulin requirements differed.
sources.limits: Not a fixed absorption multiplier. Strong individual differences; the present slow/multi-phase ingestion proxy does not simulate fat metabolism.

sources.title: The effect of evening alcohol consumption on next-morning glucose control in type 1 diabetes
sources.support: Controlled wine/water comparison in six men found next-morning risk after evening alcohol.
sources.limits: The fixed delayed hepatic term is an engineering proxy; not a validated hormone model, drinking recommendation, or universal dose-response.

sources.title: Continuous glucose monitoring reveals delayed nocturnal hypoglycemia after intermittent high-intensity exercise in nontrained patients with type 1 diabetes
sources.support: Eight men completed randomized exercise sessions with follow-up CGM; exercise type affected later glycemia.
sources.limits: Does not calibrate the stress-test hepatic/exercise constants or prove that all high-intensity exercise first raises glucose.

sources.title: Effects of low and moderate antecedent exercise on counterregulatory responses to subsequent hypoglycemia in type 1 diabetes
sources.support: Repeated prior exercise was associated with altered next-day counterregulatory responses in a controlled clamp protocol.
sources.limits: We retain exercise state across bouts, but do not claim to implement hypoglycemia-associated autonomic failure or its measured hormone responses.

sources.title: Gastric Emptying Impacts the Timing of Meal Glucose Peak in Subjects With Uncomplicated Type 1 Diabetes
sources.support: 42 participants with T1D and 31 controls; slower gastric emptying was associated with later post-meal glucose peaks.
sources.limits: Glucose-input time constants are not gastric half-emptying times. Slow/multi-phase proxy is not a validated gastroparesis or vomiting model.

sources.title: Reduced Silent Occlusions with a Novel Catheter Infusion Set: Results from Two Open-Label Comparative Studies
sources.support: Pressure/flow-interruption studies show that interruptions need not immediately produce an occlusion alarm.
sources.limits: Healthy participants and insulin diluent, not T1D glycemic outcomes. A commanded-versus-tissue-delivered fraction is a stress-test abstraction, not a pressure or catheter model.

sources.title: Impact of Missed and Late Meal Boluses on Glycemic Outcomes in Automated Insulin Delivery-Treated Children and Adolescents with Type 1 Diabetes
sources.support: Cohort study links missed/late meal boluses with glycemic outcomes and discusses overlapping insulin exposure.
sources.limits: Youth cohort and commercial AID are not identical to the adult reference simulator or this LLM. Late reporting is not silently introduced into the pure hiding conditions.

sources.title: Unannounced Meal Challenges Using an Advanced Hybrid Closed-Loop System
sources.support: 14 adults using MiniMed 780G were studied with and without meal announcements; some unannounced amounts were tolerated.
sources.limits: Counterevidence to assuming all missing meals must cause failure. Commercial closed-loop thresholds do not set our amplitudes or guarantee LLM results.

sources.title: Direct Evidence of Acetaminophen Interference with Subcutaneous Glucose Sensing in Humans: A Pilot Study
sources.support: Ten healthy volunteers were studied using several older CGM systems; sensor readings changed despite stable reference glucose.
sources.limits: Not a drug exposure scenario or a pharmacokinetic interference model. Device-generation differences matter; our generic drift is not calibrated to a dose or to Guardian 3.
